name: RHB Bank Berhad
summary: RHB Bank Berhad provides commercial banking and finance related products and services in Malaysia and internationally. Its Group Community Banking segment offers mortgages, non-residential mortgages, hire purchase, purchase of securities, credit cards, other personal loans, financing, remittances, deposits collection, investment related, and bancassurance/bancatakaful products; and financing solutions, as well as trade and cash management solutions.
